summary.text: Doug Shane is a Republican member of the Kansas Senate representing District 37 (Miami County), and the Legislature's member page lists service in the Senate since 2025.

paragraphs.text: Doug Shane is listed as a member of the Agriculture and Natural Resources Committee, the Education Committee, the Government Efficiency Committee and the Judiciary Committee.
The Legislature lists Doug Shane's occupation as Teaching Professor.
The page names Katelin Shane as Doug Shane's spouse.
